comments.author: DocHolidayPhD
comments.body: Re-playable is truly in the eyes of the player-base. Whether or not someone will want to play the game relative to wanting to even re-playing is more of a subjective evaluation rather than a claim a game-maker can make.

comments.author: LeLand_Land
comments.body: IMO - AI assets are just an evolution of the assets store but with a slight twist of personal control which gets misunderstood internally as creativity. Yes, describing what you want requires skill, but at the end of the day the asset you generated and the asset you bought fundamentally share the same place in your game. You didn't make it and it is filling a gap where your skills were not able to address. Which I should emphasize, is fine, except when one markets it as skill or innovation.
